snippet.title: Protocol: Umbra - Teaser
snippet.description:
You are the AI of a spaceship orbiting a mysterious celestial body at the edge of the solar system. While the crew sleeps, you stay awake — watching through cameras, monitoring the vessel, and searching for anomalies.

At first, it’s just small things: an object out of place. But the longer you observe, the stranger it gets — and the harder it is to trust what you see.

Protocol: Umbra is an unsettling, observation-driven psychological horror game inspired by I’m on Observation Duty and FNaF, built in Python with Pygame-CE and powered by my own UI framework, Tessella.

You can check it out here:
https://cuaitzzz.itch.io/protocol-umbra

Protocol: Umbra is still in alpha, and both the game and the UI framework powering it (Tessella, my graduation project) are evolving. If you’d like to help shape them, you can share your feedback in this form:
https://forms.gle/rgN1Btn9HWxA2wja8
